name: new
description: Create a new monorepo (Nx TS preset + release/pipeline overlay)

options.name: yes
options.description: accept defaults for anything not passed as a flag

options.name: scope
options.description: npm scope for publishable packages (e.g. @demo)

options.name: registry
options.description: package registry: azure-artifacts | npm | none (publishes no packages)

options.name: organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization

options.name: project
options.description: Azure DevOps project

options.name: artifacts-feed
options.description: Azure Artifacts feed

options.name: agent
options.description: CI build agent: a vmImage (e.g. ubuntu-latest) or self-hosted pool name

options.name: variable-group
options.description: Azure DevOps variable group holding the npm PAT

options.name: npm-auth
options.description: how npm authenticates to an Azure Artifacts feed: pat (default) | build-identity (npmAuthenticate@0, no PAT; --ci azure only)

options.name: ci
options.description: CI provider

options.name: test-runner
options.description: unit-test runner: jest | vitest

options.name: nx-cloud
options.description: connect the workspace to Nx Cloud (remote caching + CI insights)

options.name: into
options.description: bootstrap into an existing directory (a fresh clone holding only .git); the directory name is the workspace name unless one is given

options.name: preset
options.description: also scaffold a whole shape of workspace, its projects wired together (web-api: a React frontend and an Express API sharing one library)

name: upgrade
description: Re-apply the latest MoNecromanCI overlay to this workspace (release config, pipeline, npmrc, commitlint, husky hook, curated scripts)

options.name: scope
options.description: npm scope for publishable packages (overrides the persisted value)

options.name: registry
options.description: azure-artifacts | npm | none (overrides the persisted value)

options.name: organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization

options.name: project
options.description: Azure DevOps project

options.name: artifacts-feed
options.description: Azure Artifacts feed

options.name: agent
options.description: CI build agent (overrides the persisted value)

options.name: variable-group
options.description: Azure DevOps variable group holding the npm PAT

options.name: npm-auth
options.description: how npm authenticates to an Azure Artifacts feed: pat (default) | build-identity (npmAuthenticate@0, no PAT; --ci azure only)

options.name: ci
options.description: CI provider: azure | github | both (overrides the persisted value)

options.name: test-runner
options.description: unit-test runner: jest | vitest (overrides the persisted value)

options.name: migrate
options.description: also upgrade Nx itself: nx migrate latest, an install, then its migrations (latest may be newer than this mnci was verified with)

name: dev
description: Start several projects together, such as a frontend and the API it calls: runs their start targets as one Nx command, so Ctrl+C stops them all. Name the projects, pass --all, or pick from a list

arguments.name: projects
arguments.description: the projects to start (those with a start command)

options.name: all
options.description: start every project that has a start command

options.name: dry-run
options.description: print the Nx command and start nothing

name: doctor
description: Check this workspace against the invariants mnci maintains (one ESLint config, no stray .prettierrc, the eslint plugin registered, the resolved eslint major, .npmrc vs the recorded registry, versionActions overrides, nx sync) — read-only; exits non-zero if anything failed

options.name: json
options.description: print the findings as one JSON document, each with its remedy

name: adopt
description: Read an existing repository and report what bringing it under mnci would involve: blockers, warnings and the step that clears each. Read-only unless a step flag is given; exits non-zero when something blocks

options.name: json
options.description: print the report as one JSON document

options.name: tags
options.description: create, locally, the baseline tag each project whose release tags are stranded under an old name needs; nothing is pushed

options.name: toolchain
options.description: retire old formatter and registry tooling, align the Nx family to one version and run npm audit fix until the audit gate passes; needs a clean git tree and leaves the changes uncommitted

options.name: nx
options.description: the Nx version --toolchain aligns to (default: the newest published in the major already in use)

options.name: dependencies
options.description: move the root package.json runtime dependencies into the projects that import them (same range), then reinstall; a package no project imports stays and is listed; needs a clean git tree

options.name: kinds
options.description: record each project's mnci kind as a type:<kind> tag (npm, Python, Go, Flutter and C# projects); a project where two kinds fit is listed with a guess and not tagged; needs a clean git tree

options.name: kind
options.description: the kind you choose for one project, for --kinds (repeatable)

options.name: overlay
options.description: apply the mnci overlay (release config, pipeline, npmrc, commitlint, scripts) with the flags mnci upgrade takes; the pipeline keeps the steps mnci does not recognise in its slots; needs a clean git tree and an nx.json

options.name: scope
options.description: npm scope for publishable packages (--overlay)

options.name: registry
options.description: azure-artifacts | npm | none (--overlay)

options.name: organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization (--overlay)

options.name: project
options.description: Azure DevOps project (--overlay)

options.name: artifacts-feed
options.description: Azure Artifacts feed (--overlay)

options.name: agent
options.description: CI build agent (--overlay)

options.name: variable-group
options.description: Azure DevOps variable group holding the npm PAT (--overlay)

options.name: npm-auth
options.description: pat (default) | build-identity (--overlay, --ci azure only)

options.name: ci
options.description: azure | github | both (--overlay; default: what the repository already has)

options.name: test-runner
options.description: jest | vitest (--overlay; default: what the repository already declares)

name: ci
description: Run a phase of the CI pipeline here, the same way CI runs it: `verify` is the sync check and then every project (or, in a pull request, the affected ones) through lint, typecheck, test and build. `setup` installs the Python, Go and Flutter toolchains the workspace needs, `audit` fails on a known advisory that has a fix, `pack` builds the per-app artifacts, `release` versions, tags and publishes, and `native` builds the apps that need a C toolchain on this OS. Exits non-zero when it fails

arguments.name: phase
arguments.description: which phase of the pipeline to run

name: pipeline
description: Add a ready-made pipeline file to this workspace after it was generated: e2e, package-zip (the dist/drop zips as a build artifact), deploy-pages (a react-app to GitHub Pages) or deploy-azure-function. Written once and yours from then on, so `mnci upgrade` never rewrites it; an existing file is kept unless --force. With no template, lists them

arguments.name: template
arguments.description: the pipeline to add; leave out to list them

options.name: project
options.description: the app a deploy template builds or deploys (a name under apps/)

options.name: ci
options.description: the provider to write for (default: the one this workspace uses)

options.name: force
options.description: overwrite a pipeline file that already exists

name: mcp
description: Serve this workspace to an AI assistant over the Model Context Protocol (stdio): tools to list the projects, kinds and commands, run the doctor, add a project, install a dependency, sync versions and add a pipeline. Register it in the assistant as the command `npx mnci mcp`, started in the workspace root

name: sync
description: Make every project agree: converge external dependency ranges declared at more than one version, then run 'nx sync' for TypeScript project references. Go is a no-op — one root go.mod means one version of every module

options.name: check
options.description: report drift and exit non-zero without writing anything

options.name: ecosystem
options.description: restrict to one ecosystem: npm | pip | pub | go

name: up
description: Show every dependency with a newer published release — grouped patch/minor/major/non-semver, with the projects declaring each one — and interactively update the ones you pick

options.name: check
options.description: report only; never prompt and never write (the default when piped, unless --yes)

options.name: yes
options.description: select every available update without prompting

options.name: ecosystem
options.description: restrict to one ecosystem: npm | pip | pub | go

options.name: no-install
options.description: update the manifests but skip the reinstall step

name: install
description: Add a dependency to a specific project using its own toolchain (npm/pip/pub/nuget/go), or — with no package — install everything. Each project owns its dependencies, so a package needs a target: 'mnci i -w <project> <package>'

arguments.name: packages
arguments.description: packages to add (a bare name or a pinned spec); omit to install only

options.name: workspace
options.description: target project, by directory (apps/foo) or basename (foo); give the flag again for each project

options.name: save-dev
options.description: add as a development dependency, where the ecosystem distinguishes one

name: add
description: Add a project by delegating to the matching Nx plugin generator

options.name: scope
options.description: npm scope for a publishable lib (defaults to @<workspace name>)

options.name: framework
options.description: node-app only: the web framework (default: none)

options.name: empty
options.description: scaffold the bare skeleton with no sample code: every kind but container and vscode-extension (node-app needs --framework express, koa or none)

options.name: app
options.description: container only: the app to put in an image (a node-app, react-app or go-app)

options.name: port
options.description: container only: the port the app listens on, exposed by the image and published by start

options.name: e2e
options.description: react-app only: also scaffold a Playwright end-to-end project, <name>-e2e, that runs the app and checks its greeting; its e2e target needs a browser (npx playwright install) and is not part of CI verify

options.name: esm
options.description: node-app, node-function-app: ES module output ("type": "module", explicit .js import specifiers, Jest mapped to match); not with fastify or nest

options.name: lib
options.description: python-vendor only: the internal Python library (libs/<name>) to vendor into <name>

options.name: publisher
options.description: vscode-extension only: the Marketplace publisher id (defaults to the workspace scope without @)

options.name: sidecar
options.description: vscode-extension only: a go-app whose six-platform build ships in the extension, one .vsix per platform

options.name: release
options.description: go-app only: release the app. Versioned from its git tag, its six-platform zips attached to its GitHub Release

options.name: cgo
options.description: go-app only: the app needs a C toolchain (a tray icon, a native GUI, a cgo driver), so CI builds it on a runner of each OS instead of cross-compiling

options.name: web
options.description: go-app only: embed and serve this React app (apps/<react-app>, added first): built before the Go app, staged for go:embed, with a dev target that runs both

name: commands
description: List every command with what it does and how to call it (--json is what an editor builds its menu from)

options.name: json
options.description: print the catalog as one JSON document

name: kinds
description: List every project kind that `add` accepts, with its language, a description and the flags that apply

options.name: json
options.description: print the kinds as one JSON document

name: projects
description: List this workspace's projects: directory, ecosystem, the kind mnci recorded and its explicit targets

options.name: json
options.description: print the projects as one JSON document

name: info
description: Show the installed mnci version, the newest published one, and this workspace's recorded settings

options.name: json
options.description: print the report as one JSON document
